sources.title: qwen3.7-flash model information
sources.evidence: Official model page, updated October 11, 2026: native Qwen3.7 vision-language Flash model; text/image/video input, text output, function calling, thinking limits, and 1,000,000-token context. Lists July 15 snapshot. No parameter counts, dense/MoE architecture, weight-release classification, or weight license supplied.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release table, updated October 22, 2026, lists qwen3.7-flash and qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 on July 21, 2026 for Singapore International. Later October 8 entry concerns US-scope availability, not original release.

sources.title: 模型上下架与更新 — Model listings and updates
sources.evidence: Beijing release table explicitly dates both qwen3.7-flash and qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 to July 21, 2026, independently confirming that the international July 21 entry is not merely a later regional release.

sources.title: qwen3.7-flash 模型信息
sources.evidence: Chinese official model page explicitly describes qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 as the July 15, 2026 snapshot, rather than a launch announcement.

sources.title: Qwen3.7-Flash
sources.evidence: Exact-model first-party page shows Qwen3.7-Flash name, native vision-language description, three input modalities, text output, and an enable_thinking=true request example.

sources.title: Model pricing
sources.evidence: Official pricing table states qwen3.7-flash currently has capabilities equivalent to qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 for Beijing and Singapore International. This is a dated API snapshot mapping, not a mapping to a downloadable checkpoint.

sources.title: Model Studio Beijing model console
sources.evidence: Direct page returned only Loading. A partial search-index excerpt displayed Qwen3.7-Flash followed by an unlabeled 2026-07-20 date. Its date meaning and timezone could not be verified; recorded as a conflict, not substituted for the explicit July 21 release-table entry.

sources.title: Models.dev qwen3.7-flash record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog dates the model July 15 and calls it lightweight/high-throughput. This establishes the assertions under review, not independent technical verification.

name.note: Display spelling preserves the baseline; official branding also uses Qwen3.7-Flash.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud publishes the exact Qwen model and its release documentation.

family.note: Explicitly identified as the Qwen3.7 native vision-language Flash series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public release found is July 21 in both Beijing and Singapore tables. July 15 is a snapshot date. Unlabeled console-index July 20 metadata remains unresolved; later reseller and US-scope dates are not the original release.

open_weights.note: Hosted API access alone does not establish closed weights. No exact-model primary statement of proprietary/closed weights or downloadable checkpoint mapping was found; clear baseline false.

license.note: Reviewed primary model pages provide no model-weight license; API service terms are not a weight license.

parameters_b.note: Total parameter count is not disclosed for this exact model in reviewed primary sources; the API snapshot mapping supplies no numeric count.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active-parameter count is disclosed. No count is inferred from its predecessor, tier, or other Qwen variants.

architecture.note: Native vision-language describes modality, not dense/MoE topology. No primary topology or checkpoint mapping was found.

context_window.note: Official context window is exactly 1,000,000 tokens; the smaller maximum input length is a separate limit.

modalities.note: Explicit input/output capability table for the exact API identifier.

reasoning.note: Thinking-mode limits and exact-model enable_thinking example establish reasoning support.

description.value: Qwen3.7 vision-language model supporting text, image, and video inputs, text output, thinking mode, and function calling, with a 1,000,000-token context window.
description.note: Replace unsupported size/throughput characterization with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Qwen3.7 vision-language model supporting text, image, and video inputs, text output, thinking mode, and function calling, with a 1,000,000-token context window.
patch.notes: July 21, 2026 is the earliest explicit Model Studio release-table date found in both Beijing and Singapore; July 15 is the named snapshot date. A partially indexed console shows an unlabeled July 20 date, whose meaning/timezone remains unresolved. Total/active parameters, dense/MoE architecture, weight availability, and weight license are not established for this exact variant. Official pricing maps the alias to the July 15 API snapshot, without mapping it to open weights.

summary: Correct release from July 15 snapshot date to explicitly documented July 21 API launch; retain 1M context, modalities, thinking, and function calling. Clear unsupported closed-weight assertion and replace lightweight/high-throughput description. Total/active size, architecture, weights, and license remain unknown; record unresolved unlabeled July 20 console metadata.
